scope.status: Scoped under .bestiary and applied only to the adoption screen until the teacher approves a rollout. The :root tokens in css/tokens.css are legacy, kept only for screens not yet moved.

moss-ground.purpose: The sanctuary floor the book lies on.

moss-ground-deep.purpose: Ground vignette and the string tag's punched hole.

herbarium-paper.purpose: The page itself. Grey-green, never cream.

paper-edge.purpose: The 1px cut edge of a sheet.

rule.purpose: Dashed dividers, plate frame, pickable underline.

rust-seal.purpose: The seal and the main action ribbon. Decisions only.

rust-ink.purpose: Rust as text on paper, such as errors (5.1:1).

seal-deep.purpose: Ring and letter pressed into the seal.

plum-chosen.purpose: What is chosen, the naturalist's hand, focus (8.1:1).

gold.purpose: Money and XP on the dark ground. Not yet used in the build.

gold-ink.purpose: Gold as text on paper (4.9:1). Not yet used in the build.

foxfire.purpose: A creature's glow, dark ground only (6.6:1 on moss).

string.purpose: String loops and the label's tie.

moss-1.purpose: Moss clumps and the right fern.

moss-3.purpose: Moss clumps and the pressed fern.

shadow-ink.purpose: Shadow tint for drawn pieces and selection text.

tracing-paper.purpose: Sheet over creatures not yet observed.

display.purpose: Page heading, top left of the left page.

headline.purpose: Species name heading the entry, in its species accent.

title.purpose: Label titles, index tabs, option group labels and specimen names.

body.purpose: All reading text. Ledes capped at 44ch.

label.purpose: Field labels, link actions and short notes.

hand.purpose: The naturalist's margin notes and the name a student writes. Never instructions, never buttons.

dyslexia.purpose: All three voices become OpenDyslexic, body 1.05rem at 1.7 leading, small 0.92rem, no italics, tilts removed.

shadows.name: b-shadow-page
shadows.purpose: A whole page lying on the ground.

shadows.name: b-shadow-card
shadows.purpose: A specimen, label or panel resting on the page.

shadows.name: b-shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: A piece lifted by hover or chosen.

motion.name: ease-bouncy
motion.purpose: Specimens dropping and settling, swatches, the stamp.

motion.name: ease-snappy
motion.purpose: Tabs and the ink ring drawing in.

motion.name: ease-wobbly
motion.purpose: The wax seal turning and the plate poke.

motion.name: calm
motion.purpose: Under data-motion=calm every bestiary animation and transition stops. Reduce motion is handled globally in css/tokens.css.

textures.name: b-grain
textures.purpose: Tiling SVG fractal noise over paper and ground.

textures.name: b-cursor-lens
textures.purpose: Magnifier cursor over specimens and the plate.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Mossy Bestiary"**

The app is a naturalist's field guide to the creatures of Coinhaven. Screens are pages and spreads of that book lying open on a deep moss ground, not app panels floating on a background. Grey-green herbarium paper carries dark ink, a dry and affectionate naturalist writes margin notes by hand, and the things on the page are physical: brass pins, torn tape, string tags, tracing paper over the specimens not yet observed, watercolor samples, hand-drawn ink rings, a wax seal and a rubber stamp. Ferns and moss grow over the page edges. The kingdom, the map and Sage stay. The bestiary is the look.

**Scope today.** This is the project's design system going forward, but it is live on one screen only. Every token is scoped under the `.bestiary` class in `css/tokens.css` and applied only to the adoption and edit screen (`js/ui/screens/creature.js`, styled by `css/bestiary.css`) until the teacher approves a rollout. On rollout the `--b-*` tokens move up to `:root`. The `:root` tokens in `css/tokens.css` (cream ground, purple accent, Fraunces headings, system body font) are legacy, kept only for the screens not yet moved. They are not the system and new work must not extend them. The top bar and the feedback button still render in the legacy look above the bestiary page.

Density is generous and the grid is broken on purpose. Pages tilt a fraction of a degree, specimens are pinned at different angles and heights, notes sit crooked in the margins, and the two pages of a spread are never the same width. Color carries meaning, not decoration: rust seals a decision, plum marks what is chosen, gold is money and XP, foxfire is a creature's glow on the dark ground. Learning clarity still wins. Texture and whimsy never cost contrast or plain words.
keyCharacteristics: An open book on a moss ground: asymmetric two-page spreads that stack into one column on narrow screens.
Grey-green herbarium paper, never cream, with grain, fibers and foxing spots.
Three voices in type: IM Fell English for headings and names, Alegreya for reading, Mynerve for the naturalist's hand.
Authored inline SVG for every drawn piece, seeded so it looks the same on every visit.
Imperfect paper radii and soft lifted shadows instead of uniform rounded cards.
One authored entrance per screen, then living creatures that idle and blink, all still under Calm and reduce motion.
Every state carries a word, an icon or a shape as well as a color.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Rust seals, plum chooses, gold counts, foxfire glows. A jewel tone is never used for anything outside its meaning, and a meaning never borrows another's color.

rules.name: The Herbarium Rule
rules.body: The paper is grey-green. A cream or warm white page with a purple or indigo accent is the legacy look and never returns.

rules.name: The Night Sanctuary Rule
rules.body: Dark mode darkens the paper to deep green (`#1f2b24`), turns the ink pale (`#dce2cc`) and lifts plum, rust ink, gold ink and every species accent to pale tints. Rust as a fill stays the same. Watercolor dabs stop multiplying on a dark page. Both the system preference and the in-game appearance setting drive it.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Fell prints, Alegreya reads, Mynerve writes. Mynerve never carries instructions a student must understand to proceed, and never sets a button.

rules.name: The Weight Comes From Size Rule
rules.body: Display headings stay at weight 400 with no letter spacing. Hierarchy comes from size and the face, not from bolding Fell.

rules.name: The OpenDyslexic Rule
rules.body: Dyslexia mode swaps all three voices to OpenDyslexic, sets body to 1.05rem at 1.7 leading, drops headings a step, removes italics, straightens every tilted note and label, and replaces wavy underlines with a plain rule. Text aligns left.

rules.name: The Lifted Paper Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft, blurred and offset downward like paper above the ground. Hard offset shadows and glows are not part of this world.

dos: **Do** style bestiary pages only with the `--b-*` and `--sp-*` tokens under `.bestiary`, so light, dark and dyslexia modes keep working.
**Do** draw page pieces as authored inline SVG from `js/ui/bestiary-art.js` (pin, tape, string, fern, moss, seal, stamp, ink ring, watercolor), colored by tokens and seeded so they never shift.
**Do** use `icon()` from `js/ui/icons.js` for UI icons such as lock and check.

**Do** pair every state with a word, an icon or a shape: "chosen" under the chosen specimen, a check on the chosen swatch, an ink ring around the chosen option, a lock and a sentence on anything locked.
**Do** break the grid on purpose with tilts, overlaps, offsets and margin notes, and give the next screen a different skeleton from the last.
**Do** give each screen one authored entrance with weight and a small overshoot, and make everything still under Calm and reduce motion.
**Do** check AA contrast over the textures. The measured ratios live in the comment above the `.bestiary` block in `css/tokens.css`.
**Do** write student text in plain language for a 15-year-old, with no em-dashes and no semicolons, and name the action on every button.
donts: **Don't** use a cream ground with a purple or indigo accent, or extend the legacy `:root` tokens on any new or moved screen.
**Don't** use eyebrow labels (small tracked caps above a heading).
**Don't** repeat identical rounded cards with hairline borders, or box a screen as a centered step wizard.
**Don't** use Inter, Roboto, system fonts, Fraunces, Fredoka, Baloo, Nunito, Quicksand or Poppins in the bestiary.
**Don't** use purple or blue gradients, glassmorphism, generic icon sets or emoji as icons.
**Don't** use color alone for any state, or a solid ring for focus.
**Don't** put foxfire or gold text on paper. They belong to the dark ground, and gold on paper is `gold-ink`.
**Don't** use bland microcopy such as "Make it yours" or "Get started".
